title_en: At Residence Kodra e Diellit-Lindje, 1+1 apartment for sale, ideal for investment!!
description_en: At Kodra e Diellit-Lindje Residence, 1+1 Apartment for Sale, Ideal Investment Opportunity!! The apartment has a total area of ​​50.64 m2 and is organized with a distribution corridor, a living room connected to the kitchen area, a bedroom with access to the balcony and a toilet. The orientation of the apartment is from the south and has a perfect organization. The apartment is located in one of the buildings of the Kodra e Diellit-Lindje Residence, with contemporary thermal facade works, windows equipped with thermal double glazing, acoustic insulation, hydraulic systems of the Geberit brand, installations for a central heating - cooling multisplit air conditioning system, three elevators of one of the most popular brands in the market. The construction is currently in the construction phase.
